# fw self-uninstall

> Reference of the fw self-uninstall command: Remove the fw binary (--purge-data also removes ~/.fx). Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/self-uninstall/

Remove the fw binary (--purge-data also removes ~/.fx)

## Usage

```bash
fw self-uninstall [--dir <bin_dir>] [--purge-data]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<bin_dir>` |
| `--purge-data` |  |
